title: March for Housing Justice
description: Demand affordable housing and an end to predatory evictions. Bring signs and water.

title: Climate Strike: Fossil Fuel Divestment
description: Pressure city pension funds to divest from fossil fuels. Student and worker solidarity.

title: Healthcare is a Right Rally
description: Rally for universal healthcare coverage. Speakers from nurses union and patient advocates.

title: Workers Rise: Fight for $20 Minimum Wage
description: Join fast food, retail, and gig workers demanding a $20 federal minimum wage and the right to organize. Bring your union card or solidarity sign.

title: Protect the Vote: Defend Voting Rights March
description: March to the Georgia State Capitol to oppose voter suppression laws and demand automatic voter registration. Wear comfortable shoes for the 1-mile route.

title: Cancel the Debt: Student Loan Justice Rally
description: Demand full cancellation of federal student loan debt and free public college tuition. Bring your loan statements and personal stories to share with lawmakers.

title: Feed the Community: End Food Deserts March
description: March to demand grocery access, community gardens, and healthy food programs in underserved neighborhoods across LA. Bring canned goods to donate to local food banks along the route.

title: Families Belong Together: Immigration Rights March
description: Rally against family separation and deportation policies, demanding a clear path to citizenship for undocumented residents. Bring signs in English and Spanish and be prepared to march to the federal courthouse.

title: Accountability Now: Police Reform Rally
description: Demand federal legislation for independent oversight boards, body camera mandates, and an end to qualified immunity. Bring ID, know your rights, and connect with legal observer volunteers on-site.

title: Clean Energy Now: Jobs & Justice March
description: Demand a just transition to renewable energy that prioritizes frontline communities and union jobs. Bring signs and join a post-march job fair featuring green energy employers.

title: Mental Health Crisis Rally: Fund Care, Not Cuts
description: Rally against Medicaid cuts to mental health services and demand fully funded community crisis response teams. Bring a friend and share your story — peer testimonials will be presented to city council members.

title: Earth Day Climate Emergency March
description: March on Earth Day to demand Colorado accelerate its clean energy transition and halt new oil and gas permits on public lands. Bring reusable water bottles, sunscreen, and handmade signs calling out the top local polluters.

title: No More Wage Theft: Workers Justice Rally
description: Rally to demand enforcement of wage theft laws and stronger protections for oil, construction, and domestic workers across Texas. Wear your work clothes in solidarity and bring documentation of any labor violations to connect with on-site legal advocates.

title: Renters United: End Predatory Rent Hikes
description: Demand rent stabilization ordinances and expanded tenant protections as Atlanta renters face double-digit annual increases. Bring your lease or a rent hike notice — organizers will compile them for a city council presentation.

title: Fund Our Schools: Stop the Cuts March
description: March to demand restored funding for Detroit public schools, opposing cuts to arts, counselors, and special education programs. Teachers, students, and parents should bring report cards and school supply lists to illustrate what underfunding looks like.

title: Seeds of Change: Food Justice March
description: March to demand an end to food deserts and corporate food monopolies in Philadelphia's low-income neighborhoods. Bring reusable bags and a donation for the community fridge network stationed along the route.

title: Every Vote Counts: Voting Rights Rally
description: Rally to oppose restrictive voter ID laws and push for automatic voter registration for all eligible citizens. Bring a friend who isn't registered and connect with on-site volunteers to get them signed up on the spot.

title: Sanctuary Cities Stand: Immigration Solidarity March
description: Rally to defend sanctuary city policies and demand an end to workplace immigration raids that tear apart families and communities. Bring solidarity signs and connect with legal aid volunteers stationed throughout the plaza.

title: Justice for All: Police Accountability March
description: March to demand civilian oversight boards for police departments and an end to no-knock warrants across Minnesota. Know your rights before you arrive — legal observers and rights pamphlets will be available on-site.

title: Gig Workers Deserve More: Benefits & Pay Transparency March
location: Civic Center Plaza, San Francisco CA
description: March on City Hall to demand basic benefits, fair pay algorithms, and protection against arbitrary deactivation for gig and app-based workers across the Bay Area. Bring a coworker and your latest pay breakdown to show city supervisors the real wage gap.

title: Hands Off Medicaid: Stop the Cuts Rally
description: Demand Congress reverse proposed Medicaid cuts that would strip coverage from millions of low-income Floridians. Bring your insurance card or a handwritten sign with your story — patient testimonials will be livestreamed directly to state legislators.

title: Defend DACA: No Deportations March
description: March to demand permanent protections for DACA recipients and an immediate halt to deportation raids targeting long-term residents. Bring solidarity signs in English and Spanish and connect with on-site immigration attorneys offering free consultations.

title: Books Not Bans: Defend Public Education Rally
description: Rally against book bans, curriculum censorship, and defunding of public schools across Tennessee. Teachers and students are encouraged to bring a banned book and share why it matters to them.
